expected_execution_change: With geometry_mode pointwise and the same dose, the per-point robust geometry reduction should change the measured spatial force direction/dose at the anchored N22 site relative to the aggregate-geometry L109 record, and may change the local role assignment at slots 12/22. The observable readouts are joint_formation, retention_after_formation, and mean_pic50, reported alongside the measured generated-parent scores. Region discovery is fixed during this frozen calibration; the extra context points (O slots 16, 19) receive direct geometry loss and are not free, while the typed slots and their anchors remain the local compatibility target.
falsifier: If pointwise curvature leaves the local role assignment at slots 12 and 22 and the measured force direction/dose at the N22 anchor unchanged versus the native-geometry L109 record, then it does not improve local compatibility and the hypothesis is falsified. This tests the generation/control outcome, not immutable patch metadata.
scientific_rationale: V00 is the only legal variant and it is the registered pointwise-curvature operator at the frozen parent dose (max_atom_step_A 0.15, native_rms_ratio 0.66, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0). The parent R02 uses aggregate geometry; switching geometry_mode to pointwise changes the robust geometry operator from an aggregate reduction to a per-point reduction, so relative spatial gradients across the 20-point patch are no longer averaged into one scalar. This is a defensible direction because L109 is chemically heterogeneous at the typed slots: slot 22 is a native aromatic N (degree 2, neighbors 6/13, N->N) carrying a strong directional donor anchor to A:VAL:116:N (teacher_match_strength 0.951), while slot 12 is a native aromatic C (degree 2, neighbors 18/21, C->C) with no donor contact (best_donor_strength ~1.5e-06). A per-point operator can therefore act differentially at the anchored N22 site instead of diluting that site's force into the patch aggregate. Only the half term is enabled (weights endpoint 0.0, half 1.0, orientation 0.0, type 0.0), so the enabled_terms list is exactly [half]; orientation is zero and the anchor is inactive as a reward term, and type is zero so no type-mixture coefficient is claimed. affinity_head_gradient is false, so no affinity derivative is introduced. The source layout_score 8.704859 is a teacher/native layout score, not a generated-score forecast; the measured generated-parent values (mean 7.7836, best_qualified 8.4339) are the only generated-parent reference and are not used as a forecast for this new pointwise run. Prior L109 rounds (R03, R04, R10) are contextual history at other operating points, not controls for this exact pointwise dose.
